d3.programmatic: per ADMM-prepared block (after the initialisation round): every Var data object compared by name with a plain build of the same network (NetworkData.build_model + update_model_with_candidate_solution with the run candidate): (lb, ub, fixed, fixed value); Var and Constraint components present only in the ADMM block; constraint rows whose active state differs

failure_policy: Failure of any prediction is recorded, never re-run or tuned (D-1 failures are explicitly NOT a stop; an infeasible local problem is reported, it points to H4). A reproduction-gate failure is recorded and the reproduced solution is used anyway. A guard-count mismatch or a harness exception is a harness fault: recorded, and the run stops for the Planner.

step3_v1_settings_reused.objective_convention: gross: model.objective with interface_settlement_weight 0, no row 18 (alpha = 0), no voltage pin = generation + flexibility (P and Q down) + load-curtailment cost + slack terms (+ zero-weighted penalties); settlement excluded (none exists in the merged model); no terminal salvage (x = 0, no storage); EUR per representative day, probability-weighted over the 9 scenarios of the block. C_central(block) = sum_s omega_s C_s, C_s = single-scenario model.objective. The block weight in the planning sum (years[y] x days[d] / 1.02^(y - 2025), NetworkData.get_primal_value) is reported beside it, not applied.

capture checklist asserted before anything is read
